title: Analysis of Creative Arts works
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Creative Arts; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Model kind, specific feedback. Learners never mock a work or a community.

skills.key_step: The child says appreciation means looking closely and saying what is good and why, kindly and without touching.

floor.question: What is the setting of a story?

steps: Say one thing that works and why.
Give one kind idea to improve.

board.say: What do you like and why?

board.do: Wait for an answer with because.

misconceptions.repair: Look at a picture and say two good things.

misconceptions.ask: Which is kind and helpful feedback?
misconceptions.repair: Practise two good things and one idea.

listen_for: Touch the works to see them better

misconceptions.ask: Your friend shows a drawing. Which is appreciation?

checks.question: Which is appreciation: "nice" or "the bright colours show it is sunny"?
checks.answer: the bright colours show it is sunny

checks.question: Should you touch artworks at a display?

skills.key_step: The child says a portfolio is a labelled folder of one's own work, kept neat, with sketches and final pieces.
steps: Label each piece with name, title and date.

misconceptions.ask: A portfolio can be made from...

misconceptions.repair: Mix two works with no labels.

misconceptions.ask: Should your sketches go in your portfolio?
misconceptions.repair: Show a sketch and the final piece side by side.

checks.question: What goes on a portfolio label?
Does a portfolio keep only your best work?
checks.answer: No, it keeps your sketches too

skills.key_step: The child says the anthem is a prayer to God for the nation, a call to unity and service, and is sung standing still.

floor.question: How does the first stanza begin?

steps: Stand still and sing with respect.

board.say: Who is it a prayer to?

board.do: A prayer for blessing on the nation.

misconceptions.ask: How many verses does the Kenya National Anthem have?
misconceptions.repair: Count the verses on a printed copy.

misconceptions.ask: When the anthem is sung you...
The Kenya National Anthem is a...
In which languages is the Kenya National Anthem sung?
misconceptions.repair: Sing one verse in each language.

checks.question: How many stanzas does the Kenya National Anthem have?
How do you stand during the anthem?

skills.key_step: The child names the parts of a folk song performance: soloist, chorus, instruments, costume, props and message.

floor.prerequisite: Has heard parts in a round.
floor.question: In a round, do all groups start together?

misconceptions.repair: Sing a call and response and name the roles.
Name the roles on a card.

misconceptions.ask: The message of a song is...
misconceptions.repair: Ask: what are the words about?

misconceptions.ask: What is a costume in a folk song performance?
misconceptions.repair: Show a picture of a performance costume.

checks.question: Who answers the soloist in a folk song?
What is a prop?
checks.answer: an object held or used in the performance
